newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Richemont shares rise on robust H1 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Richemont shares rise on robust H1 earnings.

text.p: Shares in industrial holding company Richemont jumped almost two percent in early trade on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange on Monday following the release of robust half year results, dealers said.
Stocks added 125 cents or 1.8 percent within minutes of the start of trade at 0730 GMT to touch a high of 70 rand.
"Shares are responding well to the results. They were very good, up more than 30 percent," one dealer said.
Richemont Securities AG, which is incorporated in Switzerland, reported operating profit up 31.7 percent to 466.2 million stg in the six months to September 30.
However, profit attributable to unit holders declined to 143.3 million stg from 152.4 million at the halfway stage last year due to a higher charge paid to minorities.
By 0800 GMT shares had edged off their best levels to trade at 69.50 rand -- a 75 cents increase.
